source: DHM Islamic Level 1 · lesson 14 «How We Pray» (11 steps). Sacred sayings are flagged and their audio waits for Dr. Hassan's review.
topic: Step 4: rising from rukū‘ — what we say on the way up and when standing

words.en: Allah hears the one who praises Him
Our Lord, all praise is for You

order.en: Put the steps of the prayer in order

quiz.ar: مَاذَا نَقُولُ وَنَحْنُ نَرْفَعُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ؟
quiz.en: What do we say while rising from rukū‘?
opts: Allah hears the one who praises Him

quiz.en: And what do we say once we are standing?
opts: Glory be to my Lord, the Most Great
Our Lord, all praise is for You

quiz.en: How do we stand in i‘tidāl?
opts: Pop up and go straight down

move.en: Bow, then stand up tall and still, like Koko — count to two before moving on.

parents.summary: I‘tidāl: rising from bowing saying Samiʿa Llāhu liman ḥamidah, then Rabbanā wa laka l-ḥamd while standing still.

try.en: Our Lord, all praise is for You

parents.tip: Say “Samiʿa Llāhu liman ḥamidah” and let him answer “Rabbanā wa laka l-ḥamd”.
